name: Cardboard
description: Cardboard is a recyclable paper-based material commonly used for boxes and packaging. Keep it clean, dry, and flattened before recycling.
notAccepted: Cardboard mixed with plastic or foam
preparationSteps: Remove plastic tape or packaging materials if possible
Place in the paper or cardboard recycling bin
tips: Flatten cardboard to save bin space
Reuse boxes for storage before recycling
Wet cardboard is harder to recycle
Remove bubble wrap, foam, or plastic inserts first
environmentalImpact: Recycling cardboard reduces landfill waste and helps save trees, water, and energy used in paper production.
